# Effects & GPU Renderer

## How to add a new effect

1. Create a new file in `apps/web/src/lib/effects/definitions/` (e.g. `brightness.ts`)
2. Export an `EffectDefinition` — see `blur.ts` as a reference
3. Register it in `apps/web/src/lib/effects/definitions/index.ts`

An effect definition has:
- `type` — unique string identifier
- `name` — display name
- `keywords` — for search
- `params` — user-facing controls (sliders, toggles, etc.)
- `renderer` — GPU pass templates resolved into shader identifiers + uniforms

export const TICKS_PER_SECOND = 120_000;
export const MAX_RENDER_TICKS = 120 * TICKS_PER_SECOND;
const DEFAULT_WIDTH = 720;

const idPattern = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,79}$/;
const safeWorkDir = /^\/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$/;

const fail = (message) => { throw new TypeError(`Cut render plan: ${message}`); };
const tick = (value, name, { positive = false } = {}) => {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0 || (positive && value === 0)) fail(`${name} must be a ${positive ? 'positive ' : ''}non-negative integer tick`);
  return value;
};
const sec = (ticks) => (ticks / TICKS_PER_SECOND).toFixed(6);
const millis = (ticks) => Math.round(ticks / (TICKS_PER_SECOND / 1000));
const num = (value, fallback, min, max, name) => {
  const n = value == null ? fallback : Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < min || n > max) fail(`${name} must be between ${min} and ${max}`);
  return n;
};
const fixed = (n) => Number(n.toFixed(6)).toString();
const id = (value, name) => { if (!idPattern.test(String(value || ''))) fail(`${name} is not a safe id`); return String(value); };
const localPath = (value, name) => {
  const p = String(value || '');
  if (!p.startsWith('/') || /[\0\r\n]/.test(p) || p.split('/').includes('..')) fail(`${name} must be a server-owned absolute local path`);

  #definitions = new Map();

    if (this.#definitions.has(definition.type)) fail(`duplicate effect ${definition.type}`);

    return this;
  }
  get(type) { return this.#definitions.get(type); }
  has(type) { return this.#definitions.has(type); }
  list() { return [...this.#definitions.values()].map(({ ffmpeg, ...publicDefinition }) => ({ ...publicDefinition })); }
}
